profile.summary: I'm a Full Stack Developer with expertise in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux, Node, AWS, S3, EC2, ECS, Cognito, DynamoDB, Python, Firebase. Holding a Master's degree in Computer Science from Stevens Institute of Technology. Currently seeking a Full Stack Developer, leaning towards backend roles, I'm honing my skills in both front-end and back-end development to deliver seamless and impactful web experiences, as seen in my work for veterinary surgeons at Movora. Experience working across Veterinary-tech, Healthcare, Health-tech, Ed-tech, Food-chain and tourism industry.

positions.description: Skills: Golang · TypeScript · React.js · Back-End Web Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · Server Side · JavaScript · Core Java

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed serverless pipeline to streamline 1K+ Whole Slide Microscopy images into medical industry standard (DICOM) and feed images to 3rd party viewer (Python, Docker, AWS, S3, Lambda), reducing research and anomaly detection time for Pathologists and R&D staff by 50%
•	Created inhouse DICOM viewer and built PACS server microservice for Pathologists to identify cell abnormalities (TypeScript, React, Vite, Tailwind, OAuth, ECS), saving $100K+ annually on enterprise software and licensing cost
•	Implemented and built 3 CI/CD pipelines with integration testing (GitHub Actions, Terraform, AWS SNS, SQS, S3 Pytest), decreasing project management time between Developers, PMs by 30% and reducing faulty deployments
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · React.js · Back-End Web Development · API Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python · Terraform · CI · Cd

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed robust web app for veterinary surgeons (TypeScript, JavaScript, Redux, Firebase, Express, Node.js, AWS EC2, S3, Cognito, Amplify, API), streamlining surgical procedures by 70% and digitizing planning processes
•	Built new features, upgraded backend infrastructure, increasing scalability to handle user growth by 300%
•	Integrated with medical industry standard DICOM & PACS, enabling data transfer with existing radiography hardware
•	Created serverless admin panels (TypeScript, React, Node.js, Jest, AWS Lambda) to allow proprietary template uploads enabling the business to acquire & onboard 50+ enterprise customers seamlessly, boosting revenue by 50% 
•	Established CI/CD workflow for the team (5 developers) for 8 ecommerce stores, collaborated testing processes between teams, increasing efficiency by 25% and enabling rapid releases (Stencil CLI, GitHub Actions, Docker
•      17th Employee at the BioMedtrix which got acquired by Movora

positions.description: Developed a Home Weather Station app utilising a tech stack that included React for the front-end, Python and Django for the back-end. Integrated the app with a Raspberry Pi and the BME280 humidity sensor to effectively monitor, collect, and display real-time weather data.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a Task Management app utilising Django and React, deployed on Firebase. Collaborated with designers to create an intuitive UI design with libraries like Toastify.
Replaced legacy systems with latest software, implementing MySQL database for efficient record storage and workflow improvement of at least 30%.
Led cross-functional team in providing technical support for hardware and software issues.
Administered and oversaw setup, configuration, and repairs for numerous Windows and Linux-based systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a customer-centric travel portal with a dynamic and user-friendly interface.
Implemented Django, React, Tailwind CSS and MySQL for efficient content management and enhanced user experience.
Built a Python-based data pipeline to gather and categorize customer-specific travel data.
Enabled personalized services and targeted marketing efforts based on demographic information.
Developed a Python web scraper with NLTK for sentiment analysis to extract and analyze holiday destination reviews. Stored data in MySQL and visualized statistics utilising Matplotlib for valuable insights.

projects.title: Similar Question Recommender
projects.description:
Developed and modeled a recommendation system to give similar questions based on a user’s query; modeled after Stack Overflow’s similar questions section.
Implemented the recommendation system using an SVM classifier along with cosine-similarity algorithm.
Utilized: Python, Scikit-learn, Flask, Git, Heroku.

projects.title: BeHero
projects.description:
Developed a Full-stack web application that serves the purpose of connecting organizers and volunteers. 
Incorporated client-side features and minimized server-side validations thereby improving the application speed and performance by 25%
Utilized: JavaScript, NodeJS, HTML, CSS, REST, MongoDB, Express.
